title: Forms and Workflows: Process Each Submission | Orchard Core
description:
A form collects what visitors type, but nothing happens to a submission until something processes it.

The Form widget posts to a workflow. An HTTP request event starts the workflow, validation tasks check the fields and keep the errors in the model state, and redirects send the visitor to a thank-you page or back to the form with its errors and typed values.

In this video:
• From a form to a workflow: how a submission travels
• Start the workflow with an HTTP request event
• Validate the fields, one at a time
• Handle a valid submission: read the values, send an email, redirect
• Connect the form: point the Action at the workflow
• Try it: errors come back, valid posts go through
• Behind the redirect: how errors reach the form again
